Inventory Revaluation Worksheet

The Inventory Revaluation Worksheet calculates average cost prices for inventory items in Manager.io. This tool assists you in adjusting and updating the valuation of your inventory based on recent data or required corrections.

Creating a New Inventory Revaluation Worksheet

To create a new Inventory Revaluation Worksheet:

  1. Navigate to the Reports tab in the main menu.

  2. Click on Inventory Revaluation Worksheet from the list of available reports.

  3. Click the New Report button to generate a new worksheet.

    InventoryRevaluationWorksheetNewReport

By following these steps, you can efficiently recalculate the average cost prices of your inventory items, ensuring your inventory valuations are accurate and up-to-date.
